title: CarbonPlan 2D tavg demo, v1 prefix (a pyramid that declares one level)
description:
The oldest of the CarbonPlan ndpyramid demos, `v1/demo/2d/tavg`, kept here for the thing its metadata does that none of the others do: six level groups exist on the bucket (`0`..`5`), but the root `.zattrs` `multiscales` names **one dataset, `{"path": "5"}`** -- the finest. A reader that trusts the declaration sees a single-level store at 4096x4096 and nothing coarser to fall back on, which is the right answer: a level nobody declared is a level nobody promised. Confirmed from `.zattrs` and from `5/tavg/.zarray` ([4096, 4096], chunk 128x128, float32, zlib). `5/spatial_ref` and `5/x` both return 200.

License is unclear for this GCS demo bucket; linked via the CarbonPlan maps project.

Expected browser outcome: draws (viridis ramp) from zoom level 3. One declared level of 32 chunks across the world is past the per-view request budget at a world view, so the browser shows the no-overviews zoom notice until then.

tavg.description: The one declared level, path "5": [4096, 4096], chunk 128x128.
